current.text: Carter is Orlando's starting center. Vucevic is his backup, and Goga Bitadze will still get some minutes.
Experts expect him to stay under 30 minutes a game. Vucevic should take about 21 to 22 minutes, so Carter probably cannot play 32 minutes a night.
Orlando has a new head coach, Sean Sweeney, who replaces Jamahl Mosley. Player roles may change.

durable.text: His value comes from defense that does not show up on the stat sheet. The expert says he does not help fantasy teams and needs to become a more reliable shooter.
He has no strong category and no weak one. Rebounds are his best category, but they are not a league outlier.

note: Carter is a fringe pick. Yahoo ranks him 123 but his average cost there is 1.3 USD. ESPN ranks him 172 at 0 USD, which is outside the 144 players we draft. His projected line has no category outlier and his best is rebounds (+0.8 z), so he fits any build only as a 1 USD last center or as a waiver pickup. Early in the season, check how Sweeney splits the center minutes between him and Vucevic. If Carter stays near 25 minutes, he is easy to drop.
